articles.title: Nearly 80% of Americans use AI Tools but Most Still Want Humans Making Financial Decisions, TD Survey Finds
articles.mainIdea: Nearly 80% of Americans use AI Tools but Most Still Want Humans Making Financial Decisions, TD Survey Finds
articles.summary: Business Wire: Nearly 80% of Americans use AI Tools but Most Still Want Humans Making Financial Decisions, TD Survey Finds. MOUNT LAUREL, N.J., March 31, 2026--Artificial intelligence (AI) has reached a consumer inflection point. As AI rapidly shifts from experimentation to everyday expectation, Americans are embracing its benefits while becoming more deliberate about where – and under what conditions – they want it applied.
